newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Biswa Ijtema, the second biggest congregation of muslims after Hajj, begins on Saturday at Tongi, about 25 kms from the capital.
A memorandum of understanding was signed on Friday between Bangladesh and a Korean company for construction of a 120 mw power station .
Water Resources Minister Abdur Razzak said on Friday that the government had decided to build Ganges barrage for the preservation of surface water for irrigation.
Internationally reputed water expert B M Abbas died in Dhaka early Thursday at the age of 85.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said on Friday her government was pledge-bound to safeguard the constitution and maintain its supremacy.
The Chinese government has hailed the recent signing of the treaty between Bangladesh and India on sharing of the Ganges water.
The government has constituted a high-powered committee headed by a university professor to probe into the alleged manipulation in share trading in recent months.
